sections.title: Mission & Identity
data: Fort Gordon is the Army's center for cyber and signal operations, home to the Cyber Center of Excellence, the headquarters of Army Cyber Command (since 2020) and NSA Georgia, a National Security Agency mission partner.

Near Augusta, Georgia, in the Central Savannah River Area, the post carried the name Fort Eisenhower from 2023 to 2025 and became Fort Gordon again on June 11, 2025, now honoring Master Sgt. Gary I. Gordon, a Medal of Honor recipient, rather than the Confederate general.

sections.title: Augusta Living: Affordable, With Strong School Options

data.subtitle: The choice is Columbia County, Richmond County (Augusta) or South Carolina across the river: schools, property and vehicle tax rules, prices and the drive.
intro: A service member's state income tax follows legal residence, not address: neither Georgia nor South Carolina taxes the military pay of a member domiciled elsewhere. Georgia residents pay 4.99% for 2026; South Carolina residents pay 1.99% if taxable income is under $30,000, and at $30,000 or more 5.21% of taxable income minus $966. A working spouse should check how both states treat their pay.

Children on post attend Richmond County schools (Freedom Park School for PK to 8, then the Academy of Richmond County); many military families live in Columbia County or in Aiken County, South Carolina. Graduation rates: Columbia County 93.4% (class of 2024, the latest found), Richmond County 84.2% and Georgia 88.5% (class of 2026).

Property tax rules differ. Georgia's homestead exemption requires the home to be your legal residence (Columbia County's takes $10,000 off the assessed value for county tax in 2026), so ask the county tax office if you keep another state's residency. In South Carolina a legal residence is taxed on 4% of value and other homes on 6%; for a Georgia duty station our reading is 6% unless you make South Carolina your legal residence, so confirm with the Aiken County Assessor.

recommendations.advice: Grovetown is about 11 minutes from Eisenhower Army Medical Center and Evans about 24 with no traffic; typical home values are $305,052 in Grovetown and $408,435 in Evans (Zillow, September 2026).
Augusta is about 20 minutes from the hospital with no traffic, with the lowest typical home value nearby ($187,663); children on post are zoned to Richmond County schools.
Balfour Beatty Communities runs about 1,000 homes (Providence Family Homes); 76 new homes opened at Pine Tree Terrace in May 2026. No wait times are posted.
North Augusta (about 23 minutes) and Aiken (about 45) have typical home values of $282,277 and $274,289; check the 4% vs 6% property tax rule with the Aiken County Assessor before buying.

source.label: Georgia DOR (homestead, income tax); SC DOR (H. 4216); SC Code 12-43-220; Military OneSource; Zillow (September 2026)

sections.title: Gates & Access
data: Gate 1 (McKenna Gate), at Gordon Highway and Jimmie Dyess Parkway, is open 24 hours; on weekdays from 5 to 9 a.m. it takes DoD ID holders only. Gate 6, the main gate on Gordon Highway, and Gate 5 on Tobacco Road are open 4:45 a.m. to 7 p.m. every day (Fort Gordon gate information, September 2026).

The Visitor Control Center at Gate 6 is open weekdays 6 a.m. to 5 p.m. ((706) 791-3071). Adults need a REAL ID, or two other IDs such as a passport, Social Security card or birth certificate, and passes need a favorable background check. Hours change, so confirm on the official site before you go.

sections.title: On-Base Housing
data: All family housing on post is privatized and run by Balfour Beatty Communities under the name Providence Family Homes, about 1,000 homes; 76 new homes opened at Pine Tree Terrace in May 2026.

The Army Housing Services Office is in Darling Hall, 307 Chamberlain Avenue, Room 129 (706-791-5116), open Monday to Wednesday and Friday 7:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. and Thursday 7:30 a.m. to 2 p.m. No wait times are posted, so ask Balfour Beatty when you have orders.

source.label: Military OneSource, Fort Gordon housing; AugustaCEO (May 26, 2026)

sections.title: Schools
data: We found no DoD schools at Fort Gordon. Richmond County runs Freedom Park School on post for grades PK to 8, and high school students who live on post are zoned to the Academy of Richmond County, off post. Many military children attend Columbia County schools or Aiken County schools in South Carolina.

Graduation rates: Columbia County 93.4% (class of 2024, the latest found), Richmond County 84.2% and Georgia 88.5% (class of 2026). Your address sets the school, so confirm it. School Liaison Office: Building 44401, 44th Street, 706-791-7270.

source.label: Military OneSource, Fort Gordon education; WRDW (September 28, 2026)

data.Hospital: Dwight D. Eisenhower Army Medical Center (DDEAMC)
data.Care: The medical center's own page lists a 24-hour Emergency Department. In May 2026 the Defense Health Agency said it plans to close the 60 inpatient beds and turn the emergency room into urgent care, with no timeline set; check before you rely on it.

source.label: Eisenhower Army Medical Center, emergency medicine (official); GPB (May 7, 2026)

intro: Whether to rent or buy is the biggest money decision of most PCS moves, and Augusta's affordable, growing market makes buying a real option for many families.
rent: Your tour is short (about two years or less) or your orders feel uncertain.
You want time to learn the area and pick the right county for schools.
You'd rather not gamble on resale timing when you PCS out.
Your BAH comfortably covers rent in the areas you'd consider.
buy: You expect to be here three or more years, common with the cyber mission.
You want to use your VA loan and build equity instead of paying rent.
The affordable, growing Augusta market fits your budget for a home you like.
You've found a neighborhood and commute you're confident about.
data.bottom_line: There is no universal right answer, but Augusta's affordability and growth make buying worth a look for longer tours. Run your BAH against the rent and home prices above, weigh your tour length, and talk to a lender and an agent who work with military families before you commit.

intro: The first month at a new duty station is mostly logistics. Knocking these out early makes everything else easier.

steps.title: Line up temporary lodging
steps.text: Book on-post lodging or a short-term rental before you arrive. You can claim Temporary Lodging Expense (TLE) for a limited number of days while you house-hunt.

steps.title: In-process and update DEERS
steps.text: Report to your unit and finance, and make sure DEERS and ID cards are current for every family member so TRICARE and base access work.

steps.title: Start with the Housing Office
steps.text: Get the housing office's read on Columbia County, Richmond County and South Carolina before you sign anything.

steps.title: Check vehicle taxes and base access
steps.text: If your legal residence is another state, ask the county tag office about Georgia's nonresident military exemptions from the title tax (form PT-472NS) and the yearly vehicle tax (form PT-471). Georgia's title tax is 7%, or 3% for new residents.

steps.title: Enroll the kids in school
steps.text: Contact the district for your address early (on post: Richmond County; off post: Columbia County, Richmond County or Aiken County, South Carolina) and bring records and immunizations.

steps.title: Set up healthcare
steps.text: Update your TRICARE enrollment so you can be seen at Eisenhower Army Medical Center or network providers.

data.q: Is it Fort Gordon or Fort Eisenhower?
data.a: Fort Gordon, again since June 11, 2025. It was Fort Eisenhower from 2023 to 2025; the name now honors Master Sergeant Gary I. Gordon, a Medal of Honor recipient from the 1993 Battle of Mogadishu, rather than the Confederate general.

data.q: What does the Army do at Fort Gordon?
data.a: It's the Army's cyber and signal headquarters, home to the Cyber Center of Excellence, Army Cyber Command, and a major NSA presence.

On post with Balfour Beatty (about 1,000 homes), or off post in Columbia County (Grovetown about 11 minutes, Evans about 24), Augusta (about 20) or South Carolina (North Augusta about 23). Children on post attend Richmond County schools.
Fort Gordon is MHA GA073. Use the calculator above for your grade.

Possibly. In May 2026 the Defense Health Agency said it plans to close Eisenhower Army Medical Center's 60 inpatient beds and turn its emergency room into urgent care, with no timeline set. Its own page still lists a 24-hour Emergency Department. In an emergency, call 911.

data.q: Does Georgia or South Carolina tax my military pay?
data.a: Only your state of legal residence taxes your active-duty pay; neither state taxes the military pay of a member who is there on orders and domiciled elsewhere. Georgia residents pay 4.99% for 2026; South Carolina residents pay 1.99% if taxable income is under $30,000, and at $30,000 or more 5.21% of taxable income minus $966.
